reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in his DM to confirm that Door 48 is his dock for Tansleigh Packaging pickups on the Saltire project from now on.

His message is already saved in gbrain, and a search on his name brings it up. Gbrain shows facts from a DM only to the member who wrote them, so this one stays private to him. I didn't save a second copy linked to his name, because I couldn't tell whether a new note would stay private.

There was no other action to take.
